value_policy.rationale: The unchanged integrated upstream lookup-first and double-lock algorithm is the control. Require at least 5% useful gain beyond calibrated noise with passing guards.

selected_idea.bottleneck: Synchronous swapin repeats a cache lookup after callers missed, and __swap_cache_alloc takes ci->lock twice for order-0 faults.
selected_idea.mechanism: Adopt allocator-first loop in swapin_sync and single-lock order-0 allocation in __swap_cache_alloc, preserving post-allocation validation and error handling.
selected_idea.expected_benefit: Remove one RCU lookup and one spinlock round-trip per order-0 cold synchronous swapin, reducing CPU instruction path.
selected_idea.simpler_alternative: Keep the existing lookup-first and double-lock order-0 path.
selected_idea.falsifier: Reject on race condition, lifetime violation, failed correctness gate, or latency regression.
required_evidence: Exact-tree independent source review including caller contracts
Fresh probe calibration under Protocol Revision 7
selected_idea.no_upstream_reason: The relevant upstream implementation is already in the frozen baseline.
selected_idea.selection_reason: Combines allocator-first reordering and single-lock order-0 allocation for maximum synergy on synchronous cold faults.
